title: DICE + AUTOPILOT: random rhythms and a slowly evolving pattern, live
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: One master page (DCE). Per track: DICE rolls a random rhythm (weighted toward the downbeats; replace your trigs or add to them) with YES, and AUTOPILOT flips a step or two every 1, 2, 4 or 8 loops so the pattern slowly evolves, with a HOME knob pulling it back toward what you programmed. NO puts the track back exactly as programmed. Live: the pattern in memory is never written. Rolls and settings saved. Needs seq-events.
